items.claim: Q2 2026: Second Quarter Fiscal 2026 net revenue declined 4% year-over-year to $2.416 billion, missing consensus expectations of $2.59 billion. Reported diluted EPS was $2.92, which included a $134.5 million tariff refund under IEEPA plus $4.1 million in associated interest ($0.86 per share); excluding this, operational EPS was approximately $2.06.

Q2 Fiscal 2026: The newer Q2 report reflects declining revenue, a 9% drop in comparable store sales, and slashed full-year guidance, contrasting with the more positive growth metrics seen in the FY2025 annual report and Q1 2026.

U.S. District Court for Western District of Washington (Alsaady et al. v. Lululemon USA, Inc.): Consumer protection class action over alleged price inflation from import tariffs and retention of profits.

U.S. District Court for Southern District of New York (In re lululemon athletica inc. Securities Litigation): Federal securities fraud class action regarding supply chain, inventory, and 'Breezethrough' legging rollouts.
U.S. District Court for Southern District of New York (Kanaly v. McDonald et al.): Shareholder derivative complaint alleging breach of fiduciary duty and false disclosures regarding IDEA initiatives.
DGCCRF (France): Regulatory anti-fraud complaint by Stand.earth regarding greenwashing in the 'Be Planet' marketing campaign.
Competition Bureau Canada: Formal administrative investigation into environmental claims under the 'Be Planet' advertising campaign.
U.S. District Court for Southern District of Florida (Gyani v. Lululemon): Consumer class action alleging deceptive trade practices over 'Be Planet' sustainability representations.
U.S. District Court for Southern District of New York (Nike, Inc. v. Lululemon Athletica Inc.): Patent infringement litigation over Flyknit footwear materials where the verdict was overturned.
U.S. District Court for Southern District of New York: Utility patent lawsuit by Nike concerning 'Mirror' interactive exercise technology.
OSHA: Regulatory inspection resulting in safety and health enforcement citations.
U.S. District Court for Central District of California (Lululemon Athletica Canada Inc. v. Peloton Interactive, Inc.): Design patent and trade dress lawsuit filed by Lululemon.
U.S. District Court for Southern District of New York (In re Lululemon Securities Litigation): Securities class action over product quality and sheerness recall of Luon pants.
